errors.evidence: The description claims there are four lines representing countries, but the chart shows eight distinct lines: Eurozone, Belgium, Germany, Ireland, Greece, Spain, France, and Italy. The description only attempts to describe a subset of these, and incorrectly at that.

errors.text_span: wobei die Werte von 1995 bis 2025 in einem regelmäßigen Intervall von einem Jahr dargestellt werden.
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are at an interval of two years (1995, 1997, 1999, etc.), not one year.
The y-axis has a linear scale with evenly spaced intervals of 50 (0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250), not a logarithmic scale.

errors.text_span: Die dunkelgraue Linie, unterbrochene Punkte, stellt die Staatsschuldenquote Griechenlands dar
errors.evidence: The line for Greece (Griechenland) is a solid light blue line, not a dark grey dotted line. The black dotted line represents Belgium.
The line for Greece (Griechenland) ends at approximately 150% in 2025, not 120%.

errors.text_span: einen Rückgang von etwa 75 % um 2008 und einen Anstieg von etwa 60 % um 2015 zeigt.
errors.evidence: The phrasing 'Rückgang von' and 'Anstieg von' is ambiguous. It's unclear whether this refers to the value at that point in time or the magnitude of the change. In either case, the numbers are incorrect for Germany's line. Around 2008, the value is ~65%, and around 2015, it's ~70%.

errors.text_span: Die hellgraue Linie, eine gestrichelte Linie, stellt die Staatsschuldenquote Irlands dar,
errors.evidence: The line for Ireland (Irland) is a solid light green line. There is no light grey dashed line. The light green dashed line represents Italy (Italien).
The line for Ireland (Irland) starts at approximately 80% in 1995 (not 30%) and ends at approximately 40% in 2025 (not 80%).

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie, eine durchgezogene Linie, stellt die Staatsschuldenquote Belgien dar,
errors.evidence: The line for Belgium (Belgien) is a black dotted line, not a solid blue line.
The line for Belgium (Belgien) starts at approximately 130% in 1995, not 35%.
The chart does not contain an orange line. Spain (Spanien) is represented by a solid purple line.
The chart does not contain a brown line. France (Frankreich) is represented by a solid light blue line.
The line for France (Frankreich) starts at approximately 60% in 1995, not 40%.
The description omits any mention of the lines for the Eurozone and Italy, which are explicitly shown in the legend and plot.
